name: langchain-salesforce
headline: Casibase: Open-Source AI Cloud OS for Enterprises
short_description: Casibase is an open-source AI Cloud OS that serves as an enterprise-level knowledge base and management platform for AI agents. It supports multiple models and provides strong user management features, making it ideal for organizations looking to streamline AI interactions.
author: casibase

sections.overview:
OpenAgent is an open-source AI Cloud OS designed as an enterprise-level knowledge base and management platform for AI agents. The platform supports multiple AI models and provides robust user management features for organizations deploying AI agent solutions. It includes components for authentication, authorization, chat functionality, and workflow management (BPMN). OpenAgent enables teams to streamline AI interactions through centralized knowledge management and control over agent behavior and access. The platform is actively maintained with regular updates and contributions from its development community.
Centralize AI knowledge for teams to enhance collaboration and information sharing.
Manage agent-to-agent interactions to improve the efficiency of AI workflows.
Implement Single-Sign-On for seamless access to AI tools across the organization.
Create chatbots for customer support that can handle inquiries and provide assistance.
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`claude install casibase/casibase`
`git clone https://github.com/casibase/casibase`
sections.usage:
```
Set up a Casibase knowledge base for [ORGANIZATION] to manage AI agents. Configure user roles and permissions for [TEAM_SIZE] team members. Integrate with [DATA_SOURCE] to enable real-time data access. Create a dashboard to monitor agent performance and usage metrics.
```
Copy

```
Casibase has been successfully configured for TechInnovate Solutions. The knowledge base now includes three user roles: Admin, Data Analyst, and Viewer, with appropriate permissions set for each. The system is integrated with Snowflake, allowing AI agents to access real-time sales and customer data. A comprehensive dashboard has been created to track agent performance, including response times, accuracy rates, and user satisfaction scores. The dashboard also provides insights into data usage patterns and system health metrics.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: ChatGPT, Claude, Llama, HuggingFace
